metadata.resourceFormat: Per-action lossy WebP spritesheets with alpha; optional AAC m4a audio track
metadata.sourceVideos: *.webm enumerated from --source-dir; filename without extension is the animation id

conversion.frameCountMethod: FFmpeg fps filter -> null output -> final progress frame count
conversion.qualitySearch: Per-image RGB integer binary search; alpha quality 50/25/10/1 as needed; encoded bytes strictly below maxImageBytes
conversion.alphaHandling: Source alpha preserved via RGBA tiles; alpha-free sources encode fully opaque and libwebp omits the alpha plane
conversion.audio: First audio stream extracted to audio/<id>.m4a (AAC; stream copy when the source is already AAC, otherwise 192k re-encode); a silent source retains an existing m4a from an earlier export of the same performance (json AudioNote); no manifest audio reference only when neither exists
